results.name: Civil War Journal
results.overview: Documentary series exploring the people, technology and battles behind the war between the states.

results.name: Civil War 360
results.overview: Take a journey back in time and immerse yourself in a 150-year-old battle that nearly split our nation in two. This three-part series explores famous and little known aspects of the Civil War, from the perspectives of the Union, the Confederacy and the millions of enslaved people struggling for freedom. Hosted by Ashley Judd, Trace Adkins, and Dennis Haysbert, all of whom had ancestors greatly affected by the war, this series delivers fresh insights and untold tales, brought to life through dramatic recreations and the Smithsonian Institution's vast collection of artifacts.

results.name: Civil War Combat
results.overview:
Civil War Combat was a series hosted by The History Channel in 1999 to 2003. It described battles of the American Civil War in a graphic, realistic level. Veteran voice actor Tony Jay served as narrator.

The series included such battles as the Battle of Gettysburg, Battle of Cold Harbor, Battle of Shiloh, Battle of Chancellorsville, Battle of Antietam and Battle of Petersburg.

One of the objectives of the series was to associate people with lesser known regiments and commands. Another one was to provide little known facts of the fields of conflict and to also give an accurate portrayal of the bloodiness of the fighting of the day.

results.title: Civil War
results.overview: Delves into the complexities and lasting impacts of one of the most tumultuous periods in American history. Through archival footage, expert interviews, and poignant narratives, traces the origins, progression, and aftermath of the Civil War. From the economic, social, and political tensions that ignited the conflict to the pivotal battles that shaped its outcome, the film offers a comprehensive examination of the war's significance.

results.title: Civil War
results.overview: Summer of 1982, a beach in the south of Portugal. Rui and his parents live closed in their worlds, blind to the failure that characterizes them as a family and condemns them to the malaise of survival. Rui will have school exams but he is only interested in music and in the exploration of imaginary worlds that he constantly sketches in drawings. Only Joana seems capable of pulling him out of his autism. The girl's vitality fascinates him.

results.title: Civil War
results.overview: After an incident where Jayden spills coke on his friends' new shirt, he loses it. Ethan declares war on his old best friend,  and it gets quite serious.

results.name: Brexit: A Very British Civil War
results.original_name: Brexit: A Very British Civil War
results.overview: The inside story of how the UK left the EU. Despite an election victory in 2015, David Cameron's pledge to hold a referendum on Britain's EU membership leads to his resignation 13 months later.

results.title: Civil War
results.overview: Mohamed D'abis worked as an assistant director and technician for many independent Lebanese filmmakers. In the winter of 2000, he left his home and never came back. His body was found months later inside an abandoned war-damaged building in Beirut. In this documentary, director Mohamed Soueid reflects on the life and death of his friend and frequent collaborator.

results.title: Civil War Wife
results.overview: Former anchor Kim Hwa-jeong witnesses the secret betrayal of her seemingly perfect political newcomer husband, Kang Moon-ho. Elegant on the surface but fatally sharp within, Hwa-jeong extends her clandestine, meticulous hand of vengeance toward her husband and his desires.

results.title: The Second Civil War
results.overview: When a planeload of Pakistani orphans are shipped to his state for permanent relocation, the governor of Idaho defies the president and closes the state's border. News Net Television, a cable news program that makes hay by reporting on political scandals, quickly spins the racist act into an overnight media sensation, creating a divide in national opinion over the issue.

results.title: The Vanishing Civil War
results.overview: A program produced by PBS affiliate WPSX in State College, Pennsylvania in 1992 on the preservation of the Bull Run Battlefield in Northern Virginia, how urbanization spurred development on historical sites, and the efforts of preservationists.

results.title: Civil War Sickness
results.overview: A young woman examines her eating disorder recovery. She consciously resists the temptation to rely on visuals of starvation and specific body weights, instead seeking to articulate the deeper questions: why do eating disorders develop? Why do eating disorders persist? And how does healing happen?

results.name: The Irish Civil War
results.overview:
The 3-part documentary series The Irish Civil War tells the epic and often challenging story of the origins, conflict and legacy of the civil war that took place in Ireland in 1922 and 1923.

Narrated by Brendan Gleeson, produced in partnership with University College Cork by RTÉ Cork as part of the Decade of Centenary commemorations and based on UCC’s “mammoth and magnificent” Atlas of the Irish Revolution, this documentary series features extensive archive film footage, photographs and materials, interviews with leading academics, archive interviews with contemporary participants and witnesses, firsthand witness accounts read by actors, detailed and dynamic graphic maps based on those featured in the Atlas of the Irish Revolution, and stunning cinematography of the very locations where events took place.

results.name: The Spanish Civil War
results.overview: Documentary series which uses film and eyewitness accounts from both sides of the conflict that divided Spain in the years leading up to World War Two, also placing it in its international context.

results.title: Civil War Terror
results.overview: Explore a battle waged by secret agents and spies on both sides of the American Civil War, the disturbing tales of hidden conspiracies of terror that targeted civilian populations, and how the nineteenth-century engineers of chemical weapons, new-fangled explosives, and biological warfare competed with each other to topple their enemies.

results.title: Grateful Dead: Dawn of the Dead - The Grateful Dead and the Rise of the San Francisco Underground
results.original_title: Grateful Dead: Dawn of the Dead - The Grateful Dead and the Rise of the San Francisco Underground
results.overview: In the mid-1960s a new twist on contemporary rock music emerged out of San Francisco. Known as 'psychedelia', it was pioneered by a close-knit community of local bands who merged traditional American forms such as folk, country, blues and rock & roll with new sounds often developed under the influence of psychedelic drugs. Bound up with the social and cultural changes for which San Francisco was also the focal point, it was a combination that made for a radical re-imaging of youth culture. This film traces the movements, events and sounds of those heady days, and traces the story of the definitive band of the psychedelic age, The Grateful Dead. Giving time too for the involvement of Frisco's other lead players such as Big Brother & The Holding Company, Jefferson Airplane, The Charlatans and Quicksilver Messenger Service.

results.overview: El jovencito Cole se queda despierto hasta tarde… y horrorizado descubre que su adorada y sexy niñera, forma parte de una sanguinaria secta satánica que hará lo que sea necesario para mantenerlo callado. Así es como la chica de sus sueños se convierte en su peor pesadilla.

results.title: La niñera
results.overview: Una atractiva adolescente que trabaja de niñera se vuelve el centro de las obsesiones de un padre separado y sus dos hijos.

results.title: La niñera: Reina letal
results.overview: Dos años después de derrotar a la secta satánica liderada por la niñera Bee, Cole trata de olvidar su pasado para centrarse así en sobrevivir al instituto. Cuando viejos enemigos regresan, Cole no tendrá más remedio que volver a enfrentarse a las fuerzas del mal.

results.title: La Niñera
results.overview: Anna, quien dispone de escaso tiempo libre para atender a sus dos pequeños, recibe un aviso de que su hijo Michael está teniendo comportamientos extraños en el colegio. Decide entonces contratar los servicios de una niñera tres noches a la semana.Su hija Noa, sospecha que su nueva niñera no es de este mundo. Noa lucha para revelar la identidad de la niñera, que es más retorcida de lo que ella imaginaba en este oscuro cuento de fantasía.

results.title: El Fantasma de la Niñera
results.overview: Debido a las apariciones de una presencia siniestra, una familia tiene problemas para contratar por largo tiempo a una niñera que se haga cargo de su niña pequeña y de la mansión. Todo está por cambiar con la llegada de la joven niñera llamada Joy. Impulsada por detener el espíritu aterrador, Joy descubrirá porque esta presencia quiere vengarse y la razón detrás de la desaparición de la ex niñera.

results.title: El criminal y la niñera
results.overview: Todos los que conocían al matrimonio Bartrand -formado por Bill y Sally - afirmaban, sin temor a equivocarse, que ambos junto a sus dos hijos, eran una familia ejemplar y unida. Por ello, cuando Michelle, la canguro de los niños (y amante secreta del padre), encuentra el cuerpo sin vida de la dueña de la casa, nadie puede explicarse las causas que le llevaron a dispararse un tiro en la sien, como evidencian las apariencias. Michelle se convertirá en la principal sospechosa, pero ella misma descubrirá que nada es lo que parece...

results.title: La sospecha de la niñera
results.overview: Una niñera sospecha que su empleador está tramando un asesinato cuando escucha el plan a través del monitor para bebés.

results.title: La Niñera y el Presidente
results.overview: Joy Miller (Fran Drescher), una esteticista de Queens, es confundida con una profesora de ciencias por Grushinsky, el embajador de una nación del este de Europa. Grushinsky está de visita en EE.UU. en busca de una tutora para los hijos del dictador de su país. Joy, tras aceptar el empleo, viaja a Europa, donde conoce al malhumorado líder de Slovetzia, Boris Pochenko (Timothy Dalton).

results.original_title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
results.overview: La madre de cinco revoltosos niños se va de viaje a Australia. Para ellos se abre un periodo de vacaciones y libertad. Pero no cuentan con que la niñera contratada es severa, tiránica y perversa; y además, muere la primera noche de su trabajo. ¿Se lo dirán a mamá?

results.title: La Venganza de la Niñera

results.overview: Cuando su negocio de canguros sufre un revés, Skipper acepta un trabajo en el parque acuático... donde sus dotes para cuidar niños pronto le resultan muy útiles.

results.title: No le digas a mama que la niñera a muerto
results.original_title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
results.overview: Tanya, de 17 años, se hace pasar por adulta y consigue un trabajo en una compañía de moda para mantener a sus hermanos durante el verano luego de que muriera la niñera racista y malhumorada que su madre había dejado a cargo.

results.title: Nanny
results.overview: Aisha, una niñera inmigrante, se construye una nueva vida en la ciudad de Nueva York mientras cuida al hijo de una familia del Upper East Side, ella se ve obligada a enfrentarse a una verdad oculta que amenaza con destruir su precario sueño americano.

results.name: Anatomía según Grey
results.overview: La vida de Meredith Grey no es nada fácil. Intenta tomar las riendas de su vida, aunque su trabajo sea de esos que te hacen la vida imposible. Meredith es una cirujana interna de primer año en el Hospital Grace de Seattle, el programa de prácticas más duro de la Facultad de Medicina de Harvard. Y ella lo va a comprobar. Pero no estará sola. Un elenco de compañeros de promoción tendrán que superar la misma prueba. Ahora están en el mundo real, son doctores del hospital. Y en un mundo donde la experiencia en el trabajo puede ser un factor de vida o muerte, todos ellos tendrán que lidiar con los altibajos de sus vidas personales.

En un hospital pueblerino de la ciudad, Omer se cruzará con Ali Hoca y la idealista doctora Leyla, decididos a luchar por dar lo mejor de sí para ayudar a la gente.

results.name: Vecinos
results.overview: Relata las vidas de los habitantes de un edificio de apartamentos y sus relaciones entre ellos, se exploran los conflictos y sucesos divertidos que pueden pasar entre vecinos al tener que vivir cercanamente con gente que tiene personalidades diferentes.

results.title: Vecinos invasores
results.overview: RJ, un mapache solitario, se ha metido en un problema muy grave al intentar robar el alimento de Vincent, un oso de cáracter antipático. Pues este ahora le manda, amenazándolo, a que se lo devuelva todo, en tan sólo una semana. De este modo, yendo en busca de los alimentos, se topa con un grupo de animales, que tras despertar de la hibernación, se hallan con un seto sin fin y al otro lado un mundo aparentemente hostil.

results.name: Vecinos - Final
results.overview: La vida cotidiana de la gente en los barrios mexicanos, donde cualquier cosa puede ser encontrada.

results.name: Amigos y Vecinos
results.overview: Cuando un titán de las inversiones se queda sin trabajo y se divorcia comienza a robar las riquezas de sus vecinos para sobrevivir. Robar dentro de su círculo social lo emociona de forma extraña, pero poco a poco se adentra en una red mortal.

results.name: Vecinos
results.overview: Un taxista soltero y humilde, llamado Óscar Leal, al que le gusta rumbear y divertirse, se la pasa conquistando a las jóvenes bellas y termina saliendo con Jessica, una mujer coqueta que se aprovecha de él cuando la suerte toca a su puerta y se gana la lotería. Con el dinero que él recibe, se muda a un conjunto de apartamentos lujoso y sus antiguos vecinos descansan del bullicio de sus fiestas. Ahora sus nuevos vecinos tienen que acostumbrarse a los hábitos extremos de este personaje sin modales, que se dedica a hacer todo tipo de celebraciones.

results.name: Los vecinos Green
results.overview: Cricket Green se muda a la gran ciudad junto con su hermana Tilly, su padre Bill y la rebelde yaya Alice. Esta sencilla gente del campo deberá aprender a vivir en una bulliciosa metrópolis.

results.name: Vecinos
results.overview: Examina escandalosos conflictos residenciales, revelando los extremos a los que llegan los vecinos para defender lo que es suyo. Cada entrega del programa presenta a un nuevo grupo.

results.title: Buenos vecinos
results.overview: Mac y Kelly Radner, una pareja con un bebé recién nacido, enfrenta dificultades inesperadas después de verse obligados a vivir al lado de una casa de fraternidad.

results.name: Vecinos Infernales
results.overview: Trata sobre una familia que reside en el infierno, pero cuando Satán se entera de que una compañía americana intenta llegar hasta el centro de la Tierra (donde casualmente se encuentra el infierno) con un taladro gigante, manda a la familia a los Estados Unidos para pararlos; Definida como una "Padre de Familia surrealista y estrambótica".

results.name: Guerra de vecinos
results.overview: Dos familias completamente opuestas terminan viviendo en el mismo barrio pudiente, donde las matriarcas inician una épica guerra que revela una impensada realidad.

results.title: Creed. Corazón de campeón
results.overview: Adonis Johnson nunca conoció a su padre famoso, el campeón mundial de peso pesado Apollo Creed, quien murió antes de que él naciera. Sin embargo, no se puede negar que el boxeo corre por sus venas; así que Adonis se dirige a Filadelfia, el lugar de la legendaria pelea donde Apollo Creed enfrentó a un rudo advenedizo llamado Rocky Balboa. Una vez en la Ciudad del Amor Fraternal, Adonis rastrea a Rocky y le pide que sea su entrenador.

results.name: Hércules: La Serie Animada
results.overview: Hércules es un adolescente medio mortal medio dios con una fuerza sobrehumana que no siempre sabe controlar. Es un muchacho que se enfrenta a los mismos problemas que los otros chicos de su edad, porque aunque su padre Zeus, le otorgó una fuerza que le sobrepasa, es mortal; es un marginado que se debate entre dos mundos, con un solo camino de vuelta al monte Olimpo: convertirse en héroe. Hércules nunca está solo, cuenta con la compañía de Ícaro y de Casandra, la madura del grupo.

results.title: Hércules
results.overview: El hijo de Zeus y Hera es despojado de su inmortalidad cuando es un niño y debe convertirse en un verdadero héroe para poder reclamarla.

results.title: Hércules
results.overview: Hace mil cuatrocientos años, un alma atormentada recorrió la tierra que no era hombre ni dios. Hércules era el poderoso hijo del dios rey Zeus, por lo cual no recibió más que sufrir toda su vida. Después de doce trabajos arduos y la pérdida de su familia, este alma oscura y cansada del mundo dio la espalda a los dioses encontrando su único consuelo en una sangrienta batalla. A lo largo de los años se calentó a la compañía de seis almas similares, siendo su único vínculo su amor por la lucha y la presencia de la muerte. Estos hombres y mujeres nunca se preguntan dónde van a pelear o por qué o quién, cuánto se les pagará. Ahora el rey de Tracia ha contratado a estos mercenarios para que entrenen a sus hombres para que se conviertan en el mayor ejército de todos los tiempos.

results.name: El Joven Hércules
results.overview: El héroe aprende los requisitos para ser campeón en ésta aventura en la cual ayuda a su amigo a recuperar el trono del malvado Ares.

results.name: Hércules: Los Viajes Legendarios
results.overview: Serie de TV (1995-1999). 6 temporadas. 111 episodios. Conocida teleserie protagonizada por Kevin Sorbo que narraba desde un punto de vista libre, la historia del semi-dios Hércules. Mezclaba mitología griega con romana. Su éxito fue tan grande que a raíz de ella salieron otras dos series más: Xena: La Princesa Guerrera y El joven Hércules.

results.title: La leyenda de Hércules
results.overview: La película nos sitúa en la antigua Grecia, en concreto en el año 1200 a.C. Allí, una reina sucumbe a la lujuria de Zeus y tiene un hijo con él. El niño se supone que es el encargado de acabar con el reino tirano del rey y restablecer el orden. Sin embargo, el príncipe, al que ponen de nombre Hércules (Kellan Lutz, Crepúsculo), no sabe quién es en realidad y solamente desea una cosa: el amor de la princesa de Creta, que se acaba de prometer con su hermano. Pero, cuando se entera de cuál es su destino, debe tomar una difícil decisión. Hércules debe elegir entre huir con su amada o convertirse en el héroe que se supone que debe ser. Su aventura le llevará a conocer lugares y seres tan peligrosos como extraños. Además, se enfrentará a la envidia de los mortales y a la ira de los dioses.

results.title: Hercules
results.overview: Hercules, que tenia tanta fuerza como cien hombres, fue enviado desde los cielos por Zeus para combatir al Rey Minos y a su malvada hija Arianna, que intentaban someter a todo el género humano. Ya entre los hombres, el Rey Augelius, impresionado por su fuerza, le otorga el honor de ser el guardián de su hija Cassiopea. Hércules cumplirá su tarea, llevando a cabo fabulosas aventuras y combatiendo como un héroe invencible contra la malvada Arianna y el Rey Minos.

results.title: The Equalizer
results.overview: McCall believes he has put his mysterious past behind him and dedicated himself to beginning a new, quiet life. But when he meets Teri, a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters, he can’t stand idly by – he has to help her. Armed with hidden skills that allow him to serve vengeance against anyone who would brutalize the helpless, McCall comes out of his self-imposed retirement and finds his desire for justice reawakened. If someone has a problem, if the odds are stacked against them, if they have nowhere else to turn, McCall will help. He is The Equalizer.

results.overview: Con la muerte de Don Ramiro, otro mafioso ha tomado el control del bajo mundo en Miami y buscará vengarse de quienes lo enviaron a la cárcel, pero no será tarea fácil pues El justiciero está decido a destruirlo.

results.title: El Capitán Justiciero en combate contra Koatán
results.original_title: El Capitán Justiciero en combate contra Koatán

results.title: El vengador anónimo 4: El regreso del justiciero
results.overview: Érica, la hija de la novia de Paul Kersey, muere de una sobredosis de crack. El justiciero Kersey decide tomarse la justicia por su mano para acabar con el tráfico de drogas en la ciudad.

data.title: El Justiciero
data.overview: Robert McCall, un antiguo agente de la CIA que lleva ahora una vida tranquila, abandona su retiro para ayudar a Teri, una joven prostituta que está siendo explotada por la mafia rusa. A pesar de que aseguró no volver a ser violento, contemplar tanta crueldad despertará en Robert un implacable y renovado deseo de justicia...

results.title: Wrath of Man
results.overview: A cold and mysterious new security guard for a Los Angeles cash truck company surprises his co-workers when he unleashes precision skills during a heist. The crew is left wondering who he is and where he came from. Soon, the marksman's ultimate motive becomes clear as he takes dramatic and irrevocable steps to settle a score.

results.title: Wrath Of A Broken Man
results.overview: Wrath of a Broken Man centers on Keith, a father dealing with the frustrations of co-parenting with his ex-wife, who keeps raising child support while blocking his access to their son. With stress piling up and emotions running high, Keith finds refuge with his fellas in the Man Cave—their unofficial therapy room filled with jokes, tough love, and real talk. Each man faces his own relationship challenges, and together they navigate the chaos, lessons, and laughter that come with love and fatherhood. As Keith learns to balance anger with healing and pride with accountability, he discovers that brotherhood may be the key to saving both his sanity and his relationship with his son.

results.title: Rameses: Wrath Of God Or Man?
results.original_title: Rameses: Wrath Of God Or Man?
results.overview: This documentary examines what historians know about the Bible's Old Testament account of the Plague of the Firstborn and about Egypt's Pharaoh, Rameses. Egyptologists discuss whether the pharaoh mentioned in the story is Rameses II or perhaps his eldest son.

results.title: The Man Who Mends Women: The Wrath of Hippocrates
results.original_title: The Man Who Mends Women: The Wrath of Hippocrates
results.overview: Winner of the Sakharov Prize 2014, Doctor Mukwege is internationally known as the man who mends thousands of women who have been raped during the 20 years of conflicts in the East of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, one of the poorest countries on the planet, despite its extremely rich sub-soil.  His endless struggle to put an end to these atrocities and denounce the impunity enjoyed by the perpetrators is not welcome.  At the end of 2012, the Doctor was the target of another attempt on his life, which he miraculously survived.  Threatened with death, this doctor with an exceptional destiny now lives cloistered in his hospital in Bukavu under the protection of the United Nation peacekeepers.  But he is no longer alone in his struggle. The women to whom he has restored physical integrity and dignity, stand beside him, true activists for peace, hungry for justice.

results.title: Shark-Man 2: Wrath of Metal Grip
results.overview: In this exciting sequel, Shark-Man faces off with his first super-villain, Metal Grip!

results.title: Billy & Mandy: Wrath of the Spider Queen
results.original_title: Billy & Mandy: Wrath of the Spider Queen
results.overview: The Spider Queen wants to take revenge on Grim for denying her the rightful place as the Ripper.

results.name: The Seven Deadly Sins
results.overview: The “Seven Deadly Sins”—a group of evil knights who conspired to overthrow the kingdom of Britannia—were said to have been eradicated by the Holy Knights, although some claim that they still live. Ten years later, the Holy Knights have staged a Coup d'état and assassinated the king, becoming the new, tyrannical rulers of the kingdom. Elizabeth, the king's only daughter, sets out on a journey to find the “Seven Deadly Sins,” and to enlist their help in taking back the kingdom.

results.title: The Grapes of Wrath
results.overview: Tom Joad returns to his home after a jail sentence to find his family kicked out of their farm due to foreclosure. He catches up with them on his Uncle’s farm, and joins them the next day as they head for California and a new life... Hopefully.

results.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
results.original_title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
results.overview: The starship Enterprise and its crew is pulled back into action when old nemesis, Khan, steals a top secret device called Project Genesis.

results.title: Aguirre, the Wrath of God
results.overview: A few decades after the destruction of the Inca Empire, a Spanish expedition led by the infamous Aguirre leaves the mountains of Peru and goes down the Amazon River in search of the lost city of El Dorado. When great difficulties arise, Aguirre’s men start to wonder whether their quest will lead them to prosperity or certain death.

results.title: Justicia Implacable
results.overview: Después de una emboscada mortal en uno de sus autos blindados, la empresa LA-Fortico Securities contrata a un misterioso empleado conocido como “H”. Inicialmente parece ser un tipo tranquilo y de bajo perfil, pero cuando se convierte en el objetivo de un robo, se revelan sus formidables habilidades letales.

results.title: The Suicide Squad
results.overview: Supervillains Harley Quinn, Bloodsport, Peacemaker and a collection of nutty cons at Belle Reve prison join the super-secret, super-shady Task Force X as they are dropped off at the remote, enemy-infused island of Corto Maltese.

results.title: Suicide Squad
results.overview: From DC Comics comes the Suicide Squad, an antihero team of incarcerated supervillains who act as deniable assets for the United States government, undertaking high-risk black ops missions in exchange for commuted prison sentences.

results.name: Suicide Squad Isekai
results.original_name: 異世界スーサイド・スクワッド
results.overview: In the crime-ridden city of Gotham, Amanda Waller, the head of A.R.G.U.S., assembles a group of notorious criminals—Harley Quinn, Deadshot, Peacemaker, Clayface and King Shark—for a mission into an otherworldly realm that's connected to this world through a gate. It's a realm of swords and magic where orcs rampage and dragons rule the skies. Can Harley Quinn and her crew conquer this perilous realm?

results.title: Suicide Squad
results.overview: Larry Baker is a young fireman whose daring exploits have led him to receiving a lot of newspaper publicity which goes to his head. His sweetheart, Mary O'Connor, and fire-department friends begin to shun him as they think he is just a publicity hound. But a daring rescue of Mary and her younger brother, Mickey, from a blazing inferno shows him to be more than just a publicity-chaser and, now, a real hero to all.

results.title: Suicide Squad: Hell to Pay
results.overview: Amanda Waller's top-secret "Task Force X" — consisting of Deadshot, Bronze Tiger, Killer Frost, Captain Boomerang, Harley Quinn, and Copperhead — is on a mission to retrieve a mystical object so powerful that they're willing to risk their lives to steal it. However, the Suicide Squad isn't the only group of villains seeking to possess the object. It's a race for the golden prize, and second place isn't an option if they want to stay alive.

results.title: Suicide Squad
results.overview: A group of professional commandos have to rescue a young female hostage from the drug cartel. Once in the jungle, they're being killed one by one by a fearful enemy.

results.title: Veterans Commando Squad
results.overview: Retired competitive athletes Gao Da, Wu Liwei, and Jin Shi are invited by their old teammate Hua Rong to travel to Southeast Asia. They learn that Hua Rong's daughter Hua Chuchen is illegally detained by a local gang, who are asking for a high ransom. With no way to find help, the four form an elderly commando team and bravely break into the gang. Ultimately, they manage to rescue not only Hua Chuchen but also other kidnapped compatriots.

results.title: Crazy Famous
results.overview: A fame obsessed average Joe escapes a mental institution with a band of misfits for one last desperate attempt to be famous.

results.title: Dangerous Moonlight
results.overview: Stefan Radetzky, a Polish pilot and famous concert pianist, is hospitalised in England from injuries sustained while in combat, and having lost his memory. As Radetzky plays the piano in a trance-like state, the story moves back in time to war-torn Warsaw. During an air-raid, Radetzky meets American journalist Carole, and there is a mutual attraction. Following the fall of Poland, Radetzky and Irish pilot, Mike, escape to Rumania and then on to America. Radetzky continues his musical career in America and meets up again with Carole.

results.title: Hustler Squad
results.overview: World War II: Allied Command learns that in 60 days three Japanese generals and an admiral party at a bordello on a tiny Philippine island. It's fortified and hard to attack, so a creative, cynical major gets the assignment to figure something else. With the help of Paco, a Filipino guerrilla leader, the major devises a plan to put four women assassins among the prostitutes. He must recruit and train them, convince his general that an unarmed woman can best a man, and get them on the island. The rest is up to them. An imprisoned killer, a nurse with a fatal disease, a chippie on the lamb from the mob, and a Filipina whom the Japanese assaulted are his team. Can they do it?

results.title: Suicide Troops of the Watchtower
results.overview: Stalwart soldiers of the Japanese Empire – Japanese and Korean alike – stand in defense of a military outpost threatened by "bandits."

results.title: El Escuadrón Suicida
results.overview: Los supervillanos Harley Quinn, Bloodsport, Peacemaker y una colección de convictos desquiciados de la prisión de Belle Reve se unen a la super-secreta y super-oscura Fuerza Especial X mientras son arrojados a la remota isla de Corto Maltese, infestada de enemigos.

results.title: Escuadrón Suicida
results.overview: La agencia secreta gubernamental A.R.G.U.S., liderada por Amanda Waller, crea una fuerza especial con los peores villanos del mundo: el «Escuadrón Suicida», un equipo asignado a misiones mortales a cambio de acortar sus estancias en prisión.

results.name: Escuadrón Suicida: Isekai
results.original_name: 異世界スーサイド・スクワッド
results.overview: Harley Quinn es transportada a un mundo fantástico en el estilo del género anime "Isekai" ("Otro Mundo"). Además aparecerán otros personajes de los cómics "Escuadrón Suicida" y otros cómics de DC, como Joker o Amanda Waller.

results.title: Escuadrón suicida
results.overview: Historia de un médico del ejército estadounidense que investiga los mareos y desvanecimientos que sufren los pilotos cuando vuelan a gran altura. Basada en hechos reales, fue estrenada meses antes del ataque japonés contra Pearl Harbor.

results.title: Escuadrón Suicida: Deuda infernal
results.overview: El Escuadrón Suicida tiene la misión de recuperar un objeto místico tan poderoso que están dispuestos a arriesgar sus propias vidas y robárselo para ellos mismos.

data.name: El maratón continúa
data.overview: Mika y Teddy reciben a un paciente de un centro penitenciario cercano.

data.localized_overview: La vida de Meredith Grey no es nada fácil. Intenta tomar las riendas de su vida, aunque su trabajo sea de esos que te hacen la vida imposible. Meredith es una cirujana interna de primer año en el Hospital Grace de Seattle, el programa de prácticas más duro de la Facultad de Medicina de Harvard. Y ella lo va a comprobar. Pero no estará sola. Un elenco de compañeros de promoción tendrán que superar la misma prueba. Ahora están en el mundo real, son doctores del hospital. Y en un mundo donde la experiencia en el trabajo puede ser un factor de vida o muerte, todos ellos tendrán que lidiar con los altibajos de sus vidas personales.
data.episode_overview: Mika y Teddy reciben a un paciente de un centro penitenciario cercano.

data.name: 22 pasos.
data.overview: El Dr. Shaun Murphy tiene que enfrentar los prejuicios de una fuente poco probable cuando aborda el caso de un paciente con autismo, y el Dr. Jared Kalu tiene que aprender a aceptar sus limitaciones como cirujano.

data.localized_overview: La serie sigue a Shaun Murphy, un joven cirujano con autismo y síndrome del sabio de una pequeña ciudad, donde tuvo una infancia problemática. Él se traslada para unirse al prestigioso departamento de cirugía en San José St. Bonaventure Hospital.
data.episode_overview: El Dr. Shaun Murphy tiene que enfrentar los prejuicios de una fuente poco probable cuando aborda el caso de un paciente con autismo, y el Dr. Jared Kalu tiene que aprender a aceptar sus limitaciones como cirujano.

results.title: Presagio
results.overview: El profesor del M.I.T. John Koestler vincula una misteriosa lista de números de una cápsula del tiempo con desastres pasados y futuros y se propone prevenir la catástrofe definitiva.

results.title: Venganza Letal
results.overview: Después de estar encarcelado durante 10 años, Driver sale para iniciar la venganza en contra de los asesinos de su hermano. En unas cuantas horas se deshace de su primer víctima, Driver tiene a dos hombres siguiéndolo: un veterano oficial de policía y un asesino ansioso. Driver intenta mantenerse un paso delante de ellos, pero al parecer su lista esta incompleta y su vida podría correr peligro gracias a una fuente desconocida.

results.title: Gods of Egypt
results.overview: A common thief joins a mythical god on a quest through Egypt.

results.name: Egypt: Land of the Gods
results.overview: Using a combination of location footage, interviews, and close-ups of rare artifacts, the series explored many of the mysteries and puzzles of ancient Egypt, though not all were solved.

results.title: Ancient Gods of Egypt
results.overview: "Gods of Egypt" was a huge box office success but the true Gods were more ancient and mysterious than fiction. Powerful and deadly, all knowing, and all seeing, they were the original Masters of the Universe. They originated many thousands of years ago in a land far away from Egypt. From the Gods of the underworld, Osiris and Anubis; to the Gods of light such as Amun-Ra and Horus; the lives and actions of the Gods of Ancient Egypt explain our very existence and our place in the universe. Prepare to experience the Real Gods of Egypt and the original Game of Thrones

results.title: Dioses De Egipto
results.overview: Después de que Set, dios de la oscuridad, toma el control de Egipto, el dios del sol Horus se une con un ladrón mortal para salvar a la humanidad del caos.

results.title: The Longest Yard
results.overview: Disgraced pro football quarterback Paul Crewe lands in a Texas federal penitentiary, where manipulative Warden Hazen recruits him to advise the institution's football team of prison guards. Crewe suggests a tune-up game which lands him quarterbacking a crew of inmates in a game against the guards. Aided by incarcerated ex-NFL coach and player Nate Scarborough, Crewe and his team must overcome not only the bloodthirstiness of the opposition, but also the corrupt warden trying to fix the game against them.

results.title: The Longest Yard
results.overview: A football player-turned-convict organizes a team of inmates to play against a team of prison guards. His dilemma is that the warden asks him to throw the game in return for an early release, but he is also concerned about the inmates' lack of self-esteem.

results.title: The Longest Yard
results.overview: A sadistic warden asks a former pro quarterback, now serving time in his prison, to put together a team of inmates to take on (and get pummeled by) the guards.

results.title: Elvis Loses His Excess & Other Tales From the World's Longest Yard Sale
results.original_title: Elvis Loses His Excess & Other Tales From the World's Longest Yard Sale
results.overview: Travel down U.S. Highway 127 from Michigan to Alabama and meet the people at the world’s longest yard sale—an annual four-day, 690-mile exchange of not only goods, but also stories.

results.title: Golpe Bajo: El Juego Final
results.overview: Mariscal de campo pro, Paul Crewe y ex campeón del colegio y entrenador, Nate Scarboro cumple una condena en la misma prisión. Pedido reunir un equipo de presidiarios para tomar las guardias, Crewe alista la ayuda de Scarboro para entrenar a los presidiarios a la victoria en un juego del fútbol 'fijado' para resultar tras totalmente otro camino.

results.name: SAINT SEIYA: Knights of the Zodiac
results.original_name: SAINT SEIYA: Knights of the Zodiac
results.overview: Seiya and the Knights of the Zodiac rise again to protect the reincarnation of the goddess Athena, but a dark prophecy hangs over them all.

results.title: Knights of the Zodiac
results.overview: When a headstrong street orphan, Seiya, in search of his abducted sister unwittingly taps into hidden powers, he discovers he might be the only person alive who can protect a reincarnated goddess, sent to watch over humanity. Can he let his past go and embrace his destiny to become a Knight of the Zodiac?

results.name: Knights of the Zodiac, The Abridged Series
Saint Seiya
results.overview: Ages ago, the goddess Athena was served by fighters called Saints who channeled the power of the Cosmos within them. Now a youth named Seiya has trained to become a Saint himself by earning the mystical Cloth of Pegasus. He is joined by other Saints with Cloths of their own to fight for Athena.

results.name: Saint Seiya: Soul of Gold
results.original_name: 聖闘士星矢 黄金魂 -soul of gold-
results.overview: Transcending eternity, the 12 Gold Saints return to protect love and peace on Earth! They gave their lives to destroy the Wailing Wall to break the way for Seiya and the Saints in their battle against Hades in the Underworld! Though presumed to have perished, Aiolia and the other Gold Saints return to the beautiful earthly world of radiating luminescence! Why have these lost souls been brought back to life? Shrouded in this deep mystery, Aiolia becomes embroiled in a duel. When he burns his Cosmo to its limit…the Cloth of Leo transforms! In 2015, the Golden Cosmo is finally revived!

results.name: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco
results.overview: Un grupo de jóvenes guerreros denominados «caballeros» (o «santos»), cuyo protagonista es Seiya (caballero que porta la armadura de Pegaso). Estos guerreros luchan del lado de la diosa griega Atena, reencarnada en la humana Saori Kido para proteger a la humanidad de las fuerzas del mal que quieren dominar la Tierra. Para sus batallas, cada caballero utiliza su energía interior ligada al universo «cosmos», sus técnicas especiales de batalla, y sus armaduras, inspiradas en cada una de las 88 constelaciones del cielo.

results.name: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco: Saga de Hades
results.original_name: 聖闘士星矢 冥王ハーデス
results.overview: Después de 243 años, finalmente se ha roto el sello de Athena que mantenía prisionero a Hades, dios del Inframundo y a sus 108 Espectros. Pandora, juntos con los Jueces del Inframundo, han enviando a los Espectros a matar a Athena y destruir el Santuario. Una nueva Guerra Santa está por comenzar.

results.name: Saint Seiya: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco
results.original_name: SAINT SEIYA: Knights of the Zodiac
results.overview: Sigue la historia en tiempos modernos de jóvenes guerreros llamados “Caballeros”, quienes son protectores jurados de la reencarnación de la diosa griega Atena. Cada caballero porta una poderosa armadura basada en una constelación zodiacal. Ellos son los Caballeros del Zodiaco, que ayudan a Atena en su batalla contra poderosos Dioses Olímpicos que han jurado destruir la humanidad.”

results.title: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco: Contraatacan
results.original_title: 聖闘士星矢 真紅の少年伝説
results.overview: Febo Abel, dios del Sol y hermano de Atena, retorna a la Tierra y resucita a los Caballeros de Oro muertos en la batalla de las doce casas, a fin de llevarse a su hermana y extinguir a la humanidad, considerando que ha llegado a un estado decadente. No obstante, los Caballeros de Bronce, quienes aparentemente son abandonados por Saori, evitarán que Abel cumpla su propósito, por lo que deberán enfrentarse a los Caballeros de Oro y a los tres misteriosos Caballeros de la Corona. Tercera película basada en el manga/anime Saint Seiya.

results.name: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco: Alma de Oro
results.original_name: 聖闘士星矢 黄金魂 -soul of gold-
results.overview: Tras haber sacrificado sus vidas para destruir el Muro de los Lamentos en la batalla contra Hades, Aioria y el resto de los Caballeros de Oro son resucitados en Asgard. Mientras buscan la razón por la que fueron traídos nuevamente a la vida, se ven envueltos en una batalla contra los renovados Dioses Guerreros del nuevo representante de Odín.

results.title: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco: La leyenda del Santuario
results.original_title: 聖闘士星矢 LEGEND of SANCTUARY
results.overview: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco: La Leyenda del Santuario sigue de cerca a cinco jóvenes guerreros conocidos como Los Caballeros de Bronce (Seiya, Shiryū, Shun, Hyōga e Ikki), que tienen la misión de proteger a Saori Kido, una joven con misteriosos poderes que resulta ser la reencarnación de la diosa Atena.  Cuando ella es atacada con una flecha mágica, estos santos protectores deben atravesar en doce horas, los doce Templos del Zodiaco en el Santuario para salvar la vida de Atena. Cada Templo es custodiado por un Caballero de Oro. Una vez en el Santuario, deberán enfrentarse al Patriarca, y llevar la cura que salve a Saori de una muerte inminente.

results.title: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco: Contra Lucifer
results.original_title: 聖闘士星矢 最終聖戦の戦士たち
results.overview: Despertado por los espíritus de Eris, Abel y Poseidón, y derrotando a los santos de oro, Lucifer regresa a la Tierra, acompañado de sus cuatro ángeles infernales, con el objetivo de vengarse de Atenea, destruir a la humanidad y proclamarse soberano absoluto del universo. Para evitarlo, Saori Kido, decide sacrificar su vida en el Pandemonium, residencia de Lucifer, mientras que los santos de bronce lucharán para salvarla.

results.title: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco: Obertura del Cielo
results.original_title: 聖闘士星矢 天界編 序奏 ~overture~
results.overview: La trama transcurre después de la batalla contra Hades, en la cual Seiya quedó malherido y se encuentra bajo el cuidado de Saori hasta que aparecen unos ángeles guerreros al servicio de Artemisa, hermana de Atena, reclamando la muerte del Caballero y la de sus compañeros por haber desafiado a los dioses.

results.title: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco: Saint Seiya - El inicio
results.overview: Nacido bajo la estrella de Pegaso, la misión de Seiya es proteger a Siena, la reencarnación de Athena, la diosa de la sabiduría y la batalla, y salva el mundo. Cuando se da cuenta de su poder oculto, se convierte en un 'Caballero' para salvar este mundo.

results.title: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco: La Reencarnación de Ellis
results.overview: Eris, la diosa de la discordia, ha vuelto a la Tierra bajo la forma de una manzana de oro, tomando posesión del cuerpo de Erii Aizawa, una joven maestra del orfanato de la Fundación Graude. Capturando a Saori Kido, la reencarnación de Atena, Eris desafía a los Caballeros de bronce a enfrentar a su ejército de los Caballeros, los Guerreros Fantasma, para rescatar a Atena, antes de la puesta de sol . Primera película basada en el manga/anime Saint Seiya.

results.title: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco: La Gran Batalla de los Dioses
results.original_title: 聖闘士星矢 神々の熱き戦い
results.overview: Hyōga desaparece en tierras nórdicas y lo último que saben de él es que se dirigía a Asgard. Mientras tanto, un clima glaciar invade la Tierra. Atena y sus Caballeros de bronce van a hacia allá pensando en que los cambios climáticos provienen de ese lugar. Sin embargo Dolvar, el patriarca de Asgard, captura a Atena. Los Caballeros de Bronce deberán enfrentarse a Dolvar y sus "dioses guerreros". Lo que no esperaban era que uno de sus enemigos será el propio Hyōga, que se encuentra bajo el control de Dolvar. Segunda película basada en el manga/anime Saint Seiya.

results.name: Saint Seiya Ω Omega
results.overview:
Saint Seiya Omega es una serie de anime producida por Toei Animation. Es una serie derivada de la serie de manga Saint Seiya (Los Caballeros del Zodiaco) escrita e ilustrada por Masami Kurumada, producida en el Aniversario 25 de la franquicia. La serie comenzó a emitirse en TV Asahi el 1 de abril de 2012. Es dirigida por Morio Hatano, con diseños de los personajes hechos por el Animador e Ilustrador Yoshihiko Umakoshi, conocido por hacer esto mismo en "Street Fighter Alpha: La Serie Animada", "HeartCatch PreCure!" y "Casshern Sins".

Toei Animation la describe como "Una Historia Original de Anime", y esta separada de la continuidad del manga de Kurumada. El autor original de Saint Seiya no esta involucrado en el proceso creativo de Omega, aunque se le da crédito como el creador del concepto original de la serie.

results.name: Saint Seiya Saintia Shō
results.original_name: 聖闘士星矢 セインティア翔
results.overview: Saintia Shō es un anime que narra historias paralelas a los sucesos de las primeras sagas de Saint Seiya. La serie se centra en “Saintias”, las nuevas guerreras que protegen a Atena. Shōko y Kyōko nacieron bajo un cruel destino que siendo niñas estuvo a punto de costar la vida de una de ellas. Ahora, ya como adolescentes, Kyōko lleva varios años fuera de casa y Shōko no sabe por qué más allá de que está estudiando. En medio de su búsqueda y mientras los caballeros de bronce de toda la vida se preparan para el Torneo Galáctico, Shōko tendrá que enfrentarse a varias aventuras en las que pone en peligro su vida. Pero sobretodo, la amenaza de la diosa griega de la discordia, Eris, y sus espíritus malvados.

results.name: Los Guerreros del Zodiaco: El Lienzo Perdido
results.original_name: 聖闘士星矢 THE LOST CANVAS 冥王神話
results.overview: Saint Seiya: El lienzo perdido - El mito de Hades, también conocido como simplemente The Lost Canvas, es un manga escrito e ilustrado por Shiori Teshirogi. Es un spin-off basado en la serie manga Saint Seiya, que fue creado, escrito e ilustrado por el autor japonés Masami Kurumada.

data.title: Los Caballeros del Zodiaco
data.overview: Un grupo de jóvenes guerreros denominados «caballeros» (o «santos»), cuyo protagonista es Seiya (caballero que porta la armadura de Pegaso). Estos guerreros luchan del lado de la diosa griega Atena, reencarnada en la humana Saori Kido para proteger a la humanidad de las fuerzas del mal que quieren dominar la Tierra. Para sus batallas, cada caballero utiliza su energía interior ligada al universo «cosmos», sus técnicas especiales de batalla, y sus armaduras, inspiradas en cada una de las 88 constelaciones del cielo.

results.title: Maximum Risk
results.overview: Alain Moreau's investigation into the death of his identical twin brother leads him from the beauty of the south of France to the mean streets of New York City and into the arms of his brother's beautiful girlfriend. Pursued by ruthless Russian mobsters and renegade FBI agents, the duo race against time to solve his brother's murder and expose an international conspiracy.

results.title: Máximo Riesgo
results.overview: Alain Moreau es un policía francés y ex francotirador del ejército que vive en Niza. Alain se encuentra en un funeral de la policía, cuando su compañero, Sebastien aparece para informarle que acaban de encontrar en la ciudad a un sujeto muerto que es físicamente idéntico a él. Ellos descubren que el nombre del sujeto era Mikhail Suverov, y que según su identificación, nació exactamente el mismo día que Alain. Al momento de confrontar a su madre, ésta le confiesa haber dado a Mikhail en adopción al momento de nacer. Como resultado, Alain descubre que Mikhail era su hermano gemelo.

results.title: Riesgo Total
results.overview: Gabe Walker, un alpinista dedicado al rescate de alta montaña, todavía no ha superado la muerte de su compañera en una caída al vacío un año atrás. Ahora le piden que vuelva a la misma montaña de la tragedia para rescatar a un grupo de personas extraviadas. Lo que Gabe desconoce es que se trata de peligrosos delincuentes que acaban de perpetrar un asalto a un avión para hacerse con un botín de cien millones de dólares.

results.title: Nowhere to Run
results.overview: Escaped convict Sam Gillen single-handedly takes on ruthless developers who are determined to evict a widow with two young children.

results.title: Nowhere to Run
results.overview: Rural Texas, 1960 -- An age of good times and innocence, when growing up was supposed to be easy. Six high school seniors know the terrible secret that will make the difference in the biggest election in the county's history. Now they must make the most difficult decision of their lives. They must become adults. Written by Concorde - New Horizons

results.title: 2048: Nowhere to Run
results.overview: “2048: Nowhere to Run” takes place one year before the events of Blade Runner 2049. The short film focuses on Sapper, a man who is trying to make it through life day-by-day without turning back to his old ways. We’re introduced to both the gentle nature of Sapper and the violence he’s capable of when set off.

results.title: Nowhere to Run
results.overview: Harry's married to Marian and things are not going all that well, so he wants out but somehow feels that a divorce is not the answer. After developing a winning blackjack system, he hatches a plan that takes years of preparation: to fake his death, assume a new identity and win $500,000 at blackjack.

results.title: Nowhere to Run
results.overview: Nowhere to Run from ORAM -- Organization for Refuge, Asylum and Migration -- chronicles the challenges lesbian, gay, bisexual, transgender and intersex (LGBTI) refugees face around the world. Lukela flees Zimbabwe for South Africa after being outed as a lesbian. Marwan flees to Syria from Iraq after he is violently attacked and his lover is killed. Naheed flees to Turkey from Iran after her father discovers her with her girlfriend. Paul tries to escape to the United Kingdom from Jamaica after being ostracized by his neighbors for his sexual orientation.

results.title: Nowhere to Run
results.overview: A young woman’s pursuit of online stardom during a period of isolation after running away from home gradually becomes a living nightmare at the hands of a stalker who has convinced himself that he holds the key to unlocking her criminal past.

results.title: ROH: Nowhere To Run
results.overview: Nowhere to Run was a wrestling event promoted by Ring of Honor. It took place on May 14, 2005 at the Frontier Fieldhouse in Chicago Ridge, Illinois. The main event saw CM Punk and Jimmy Rave end their violent feud in a Steel Cage Match.

results.title: McFly: Nowhere Left to Run
results.overview: Updating "Thriller" for the "Twilight" generation, "Nowhere Left to Run" is a blood, sweat and scream-soaked vampire spectacular soundtracked by songs from McFly's latest album, Above the Noise, including huge, hit singles "Party Girl" and Taio Cruz collaboration "Shine a Light". Fun, frightening and fast-paced, glossily-produced and featuring gorgeous female fans with fangs, this is McFly as even their mothers would be scared to see them. The 30 minute film follows the boys from a daytime TV sofa to an isolated mansion where they try to ensure the future of McFly by taking their shirts off and plotting to murder one of their members.

results.title: Nowhere to Run: Abused by our Coach
results.original_title: Nowhere to Run: Abused by our Coach
results.overview: After Charlie Webster was abused by her coach she never spoke to her friends in her running club again. Then years on an email sets her on a journey back to her past to find them.

results.title: Nowhere to Run: Nigeria's Climate and Environmental Crisis
results.original_title: Nowhere to Run: Nigeria's Climate and Environmental Crisis
results.overview: 2015 English-, Hausa-, and Ibo-language film by Dan McCain.

results.title: All Souls
results.overview: A young confidential informant is sent on a dangerous undercover operation. It's a no-holds-barred look at the vulnerable foot soldiers of the War on Drugs, young criminals who are pressured to work for the police.

results.title: Sin Escape
results.overview: Un día, Nathan Harper ve su foto en una página de personas desaparecidas. Sospechando que sus padres pudieron secuestrarlo siendo un bebé, empieza a investigar y descubre que sus padres no son quienes dicen ser. Pero lo peor es que, de repente, sin saber cómo ni por qué, empieza a ser perseguido por la policía, por agentes del gobierno e incluso por asesinos a sueldo, convirtiéndose en la víctima de una misteriosa conspiración. A partir de ese momento el objetivo de su vida será averiguar su verdadera identidad.

results.title: Sin Escape
results.overview: Una familia estadounidense, recién llegada a un país del Sudeste Asiático por motivos laborales, se encuentra atrapada en medio de un violento golpe de Estado. Desesperadamente intentarán escapar de un ambiente en el que los extranjeros, como ellos, son inmediatamente ejecutados.

results.title: Sin Escape
results.overview: Sam Gillen (Van Damme) es un convicto quebequense que escapa de la custodia federal estadounidense por el robo a un banco y asesinato. En su último golpe, el socio de Sam mató accidentalmente a un guardia y Sam fue el único arrestado en la escena del crimen. Al momento de ayudarlo a escapar de la custodia, su socio muere en el intento, obligando a Sam a ir solo en busca del botín que está enterrado dentro de la propiedad de una granja habitada por Clydie Anderson (Arquette), una madre viuda con dos hijos

results.title: Escape Room: Sin Salida
results.overview: Seis extraños que se ven envueltos en circunstancias más allá de su control deben usar su ingenio para sobrevivir.

results.title: Sin escape
results.overview: Brent Magna (Ethan Hawke), un piloto de coches de carreras, tiene que afrontar una difícil misión cuando su esposa es secuestrada. Solo cuenta con la ayuda de una joven hacker (Selena Gomez), y su única esperanza de salvar a su esposa es seguir las órdenes de la voz misteriosa que vigila todos sus movimientos mediante cámaras montadas en el coche que conduce Brent.

results.title: Habitación De Escape: Sin Salida
results.overview: Cuatro amigos. Una habitación. Muchos secretos. Y una única vía de salida: la verdad. Una comedia que pone patas arriba los planes de dos parejas dispuestas a pasar una gran noche en un escape room. Si quieren salir de este juego tan imprevisible como alocado, tendrán que poner a prueba su amistad. Para ellos ha llegado la hora de la verdad.

results.title: Nowhere to Hide
results.overview: Tras el asesinato de un inspector de policía, su viuda descubre con horror que, además, su única hija ha sido secuestrada. Mientras conduce en su búsqueda, la voz del técnico de ayuda en carretera que sale a través del interfono instalado en su vehículo, le comunica que es él quien la tiene secuestrada.

results.title: Follow Me
results.overview: Una famosa personalidad de las redes sociales viaja con sus amigos a Moscú para grabar nuevo contenido para su exitoso canal. Buscando vivir las situaciones más extremas con el fin de conseguir nuevos espectadores, el grupo se adentra en un mundo de misterio, excesos y peligro. Cuando la línea entre la vida real y la social se difumina, al grupo no le quedará otro remedio que luchar para garantizar su propia supervivencia.

results.title: Santa Cláusula 3: Complot En El Polo Norte
results.original_title: The Santa Clause 3: The Escape Clause
results.overview: La felicidad de la Navidad se convierte en un caos enorme cuando Scott Calvin (Tim Allen), también conocido como Santa, invita a sus suegros (Ann-Margret, Alan Arkin) a su casa y simultáneamente debe enfrentarse a Jack Frost (Martin Short) quien desea apoderarse del Polo Norte, su familia y Head Elf Curtis deben unirse a él para frustrar su nefasto plan.

results.title: La Historia sin Fin III
results.original_title: Die unendliche Geschichte III - Rettung aus Phantásien
results.overview: El deseo de Bastian de tener un hermano o hermana se convierte finalmente en realidad cuando su padre anuncia que se va a volver a casar. Desafortunadamente, Bastian no congenia con su hermanastra Nicole. Sus problemas aumentan cuando se convierte en víctima de Los Bestias, una banda de fanfarrones de su nuevo colegio. Ocultándose de ellos en la biblioteca del colegio, Bastian encuentra por casualidad su libro preferido, -La historia interminable-, se esconde en un cuarto oscuro y pide el deseo de regresar a Fantasía. Desconcertados por su desaparición, Los Bestias deciden abandonar su búsqueda, pero descubren el libro en el suelo. Slip, el líder de la pandilla, comienza a leerlo y se da cuenta del poder que posee.

results.title: The Little Things
results.overview: Deputy Sheriff Joe "Deke" Deacon joins forces with Sgt. Jim Baxter to search for a serial killer who's terrorizing Los Angeles. As they track the culprit, Baxter is unaware that the investigation is dredging up echoes of Deke's past, uncovering disturbing secrets that could threaten more than his case.

results.title: The Little Things
results.overview: The Little Things explores the staff, families and children within the walls of Derian House Children’s Hospice. Their personal stories highlight the profound impact of the support offered whilst breaking down prejudices surrounding children’s hospice care, illuminating the enduring power of hope and resilience in the face of life's most profound challenges.

results.title: The Little Things
results.overview: After a failed suicide attempt, Claire has nothing better to do than go to work. During a cigarette break, she meets Simon, a man with a few issues of his own.

results.title: The Little Things
results.overview: Fourteen-year-old George has to find her own way to celebrate her birthday when everyone else forgets it.

results.title: The Little Things
results.overview: Exploring the lives of everyday people who through life encounter the special gifts they have, or at least believe they have.

results.title: All the Little Things
results.overview: An accomplished molecular biologist moves out of the lab in a quest to make an encyclopedia documenting all the fruit fly species in North America.

results.title: The Little Things
results.overview: An elderly woman braves the outdoors for the first time after having fallen a year prior, when her dog Baylee, wants to go for a walk.

results.title: The Little Things
results.overview: When a fussy businessman books a last minute Airbnb, he discovers what dark secrets his matronly hostess harbors beneath her floorboards...

results.title: The Little Things
results.overview: A character-rich portrait of life and love among late twentysomethings living and working in New York City.

results.title: All the Little Things We Kill
results.original_title: All the Little Things We Kill
results.overview: A college professor takes her students hostage to force the passage of a bill that bans semi-automatic weapons.

results.title: The Hall of Little Things
results.overview: Lea, a soul wandering in despair, embarks on a surreal journey through the winding streets of Jakarta. Driven by the haunting image of a mysterious young girl from her recurring nightmare, she delves into the city's labyrinthine alleyways in search of  unlocking her own self clarity and redemption.

results.title: The Little Things
results.overview: The film follows Yudale, a religious youth from the settlements, as he experiences a crisis of faith. As he receives a camera from Michal, a Tel Aviv director who teaches him how to film, Yehuda documents his life on the line between the settlement Tko’a and Tel Aviv: his final conversations with his dying father—Rabbi Menachem Fruman– their joint study, and saying goodbye to him. When his father dies, Yehuda chooses to take off his kippah. During the year of mourning, he continues to document his life outside the religious world: exploring Tel Aviv, talking to Michal, and his new perspective on his family and their way of life. Elisheva,  a newly observant Jew orphaned from her mother, comes into his life as a soul mate exactly at the moment when he loses hope of finding his way.

results.title: All About the Little Things
results.overview: The film takes place in one house, at an unspecified place, at an unspecified time. In this house, twelve dialogue stories take place and all have one thing in common - oppressive hopelessness. We witness everyday problems that become absurd under a distorted lens and become all the more real. The film follows with almost morbid interest the fates of people who, based on their actions and incompetence, are doomed. The question remains how far the characters from this "house" are.

results.title: The Little Things that Run the World
results.original_title: The Little Things that Run the World
results.overview: THE LITTLE THINGS THAT RUN THE WORLD introduces viewers to a diverse group of scientists, nature lovers, gardeners, farmers, and general bug enthusiasts in exploring the importance of flying insects amid rapid declines in their numbers.  This most numerous group of animals on the planet by far - three quarters of all species - have also been called the “glue of life” on Earth.  They literally hold ecosystems together.  Insects were the first animals to evolve flight more than 400 million years ago, and they survived all five of the known mass extinctions since then.  But, there is evidence that the pace of decline among insects in parts of the world today is fast approaching the levels of previous catastrophes.

results.title: the little things that moves the world
results.original_title: the little things that moves the world
results.overview: A short film about small and everyday movements that natures makes.  From birds and fishes that create those beautiful movements to little splashes and ants walking by.  These kind of movements, the everyday little movements, moves our world and make it beautiful.

results.title: National Theatre Live: The Little Big Things
results.original_title: National Theatre Live: The Little Big Things
results.overview: When one moment changes everything, Henry's family are split between a past they no longer recognise, and a future they could never foresee. Based on the Sunday Times best-selling autobiography by Henry Fraser, The Little Big Things is an uplifting and colourful new British musical with an explosive theatrical pop soundtrack in a world premiere production.

results.title: The Magical World of Winnie the Pooh: Little Things Mean a Lot
results.original_title: The Magical World of Winnie the Pooh: Little Things Mean a Lot
results.overview: Four charming animated tales from Winnie the Pooh and his friends, helping to teach children some valuable lessons about growing up and dealing with friends. Includes the stories: "The Wishing Bear", "Honey for a Bunny", "Eeyi, Eeyi, Eeyore" and "Monkey See, Monkey Do Better".

results.title: Charlotte Film Festival Shorts Programs: JOY IN THE LITTLE THINGS (Documentary Shorts #1)
results.original_title: Charlotte Film Festival Shorts Programs: JOY IN THE LITTLE THINGS (Documentary Shorts #1)
results.overview: From a Venezuelan immigrant delivering traditional cuisine via bicycle in San Francisco to NYC’s most iconic driving instructor preparing students for the road ahead, the characters in this collection of documentary short films live out their passions on a daily basis. Titles: Arepas en Bici | Livestreams with GrandmaPuzzles | The Endless Wave | TRIP-tych! | Looking Forward | Shanti Rides Shotgun | I Am Louise

results.overview: Comedia negra que trata sobre una pareja que lleva 10 años de matrimonio pero cuyas desavenencias a la hora de enfrentarse con una infestación conducirán a una serie de asesinatos.

El olfato de Deke para las "pequeñas cosas" resulta inquietantemente preciso, pero su voluntad de eludir las reglas envuelve a Baxter en un dilema desgarrador. Mientras tanto, Deke debe luchar con un oscuro secreto de su pasado.

results.title: The Matrix
results.overview: Set in the 22nd century, The Matrix tells the story of a computer hacker who joins a group of underground insurgents fighting the vast and powerful computers who now rule the earth.

results.title: The Matrix Resurrections
results.overview: Plagued by strange memories, Neo's life takes an unexpected turn when he finds himself back inside the Matrix.

results.title: The Matrix Revolutions
results.overview: The human city of Zion defends itself against the massive invasion of the machines as Neo fights to end the war at another front while also opposing the rogue Agent Smith.

results.title: The Matrix Reloaded
results.overview: The Resistance builds in numbers as humans are freed from the Matrix and brought to the city of Zion. Neo discovers his superpowers, including the ability to see the code inside the Matrix. With machine sentinels digging to Zion in 72 hours, Neo, Morpheus and Trinity must find the Keymaker to ultimately reach the Source.

results.title: The Matrix Revisited

Interviews with various cast and crew members inform us how they were affected by the deaths of Gloria Foster and Aaliyah, and also delve into the making of the visual effects that takes up a lot of screen time. results.title: Making "The Matrix"
results.overview: A promotional making-of documentary for the film The Matrix (1999) that devotes its time to explaining the digital and practical effects contained in the film. This is very interesting, seeing as how they're giving away the cinematic secrets that they created solely for the this movie, that have now been spoofed and referenced in countless other films.

results.title: The Matrix: Generation
results.overview: After the 1999 premiere of the first Matrix movie, it became a pop culture phenomenon. A special documentary about the Matrix saga and its prophetic aspects.

results.title: The Matrix

results.title: Making 'Enter the Matrix'
results.overview: A look at Enter the Matrix: The game's story picks up just before The Matrix Reloaded and runs parallel to that of the film. Bend the rules of the Matrix with martial arts, pilot the fastest hovercraft in the fleet, or just fight with lots of guns.

results.title: The Matrix
results.overview: "A Matriz" is a short documentary about Praça da Matriz, an important square in Porto Alegre. Through images, stories, and reflections, it explores the place’s history, architecture, and role in everyday life.

results.name: The Approval Matrix
results.overview: Inspired by New York Magazine's biweekly pop culture roundup, 'The Approval Matrix' is a hilarious half-hour analysis of the most buzzed about topics out there. Our host, Neal Brennan, co-creator of Chappelle's Show, and his panel of insiders, celebs, thought leaders, and critics face off on the subjects that are on everyone's minds. 'The Approval Matrix' itself comes to life with each of the four quadrants (Highbrow, Lowbrow, Despicable and Brilliant) to help define the debate.

results.title: Deep Impact
results.overview: A seven-mile-wide space rock is hurtling toward Earth, threatening to obliterate the planet. Now, it's up to the president of the United States to save the world. He appoints a tough-as-nails veteran astronaut to lead a joint American-Russian crew into space to destroy the comet before impact. Meanwhile, an enterprising reporter uses her smarts to uncover the scoop of the century.

results.title: DEEP 125 IMPACT
results.original_title: 宗明建設 presents DEEP 125 IMPACT
results.overview: DEEP 125 Impact took place on May 5, 2025, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan, promoted by DEEP. The main event features Ryuya Fukuda defending his Bantamweight Championship against Juntaro Ushiku in a five-round title bout. The co-main event showcases Yoichiro Sato defending his Welterweight Championship against Kohei Kadono, while featherweight Grand Prix semifinals include Yutaro Muramoto vs. Sho Sekihara and additional contenders. Other notable fights feature Saori Oshima vs. Yeji Lee in a women’s microweight clash and Yuto Muramoto vs. Sho Sekihara.

results.title: Deep Impact
results.overview: “Deep Impact” explores our deep fatalistic tendencies to design our own catastrophic scenarios in order to enrich our monotonous lives through our simulations of collapse.

results.title: ECW Deep Impact
results.overview: This anthology of wrestling mayhem from Extreme Championship Wrestling promises an "emotional barbed wire hell," and it delivers. In one gory match, Terry Funk, whose specialty is taking more punishment than any sane person could stand, meets the evil and vicious Sabu in a ring surrounded with barbed wire. In their battle for the ECW World Heavyweight championship, it doesn't take long for them to be smeared with blood, beating the hell out of each other while hopelessly entangled in strands of wire. It eventually takes several men with tools to cut them free as the announcer proclaims that the action just witnessed is too brutal to ever be shown on television. In another match Steve Austin, before he became "Stone Cold" and attained primetime stardom, battles in a "three-way dance" with other notorious bad asses Mikey Whipwreck and the Sandman. And Mick Foley, in his "Cactus Jack" persona, tangles with Terry Funk and gets burned (literally).

results.title: DEEP 124 IMPACT
results.overview: The DEEP 124 IMPACT takes place on March 1, 2025, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan. This mixed martial arts event features fighters like Ryuya Fukuda, Yuto Uemura, Yuki Narita, and Kota Shirawaka in a Featherweight Grand Prix opening round. Competitors battle across multiple bouts, including a main event between Yuki Motoya and Yutaro Muramoto. The night promises intense MMA action.

Other fighters include Rikito Tago, Sora Sugiyama, Hiro Sasaki, and Akihiro Takanabe across the card. It’s a notable night of MMA action in DEEP’s 2025 season, broadcast live on U-NEXT and YouTube Membership.

results.title: Post Impact
results.overview: Meteor Bay-Leder 7 struck earth on October 18th, 2012. Causing earthquakes, tidal waves, and a dust cloud that soon covered most of the Northern hemisphere, it changed the face of our planet forever.

results.title: Impacto profundo
results.overview: Leo Biederman se ha apuntado al Club de Astronomía del colegio, más para estar con Sarah Hotchner que para mirar el cielo. Un día descubre en un cúmulo de estrellas una gran mancha blanca que resulta ser un cometa que está a punto de chocar con la Tierra. Mientras tanto, Jenny Learner, una ambiciosa reportera de la NBC, rastreando una posible historia escandalosa de un senador, descubre accidentalmente que Ellie (E.L.E.) no es el nombre de su amante, sino de un cometa que amenaza con destruir la Tierra.

results.title: Superman II
results.overview: Tres criminales procedentes del planeta Krypton, a los que el padre de Superman condenó a vagar por el espacio, eluden su condena y llegan a la Tierra para enfrentarse a Superman en una batalla cósmica por la supremacía sobre el planeta. El superhéroe sigue ocultando su identidad tras la tímida personalidad del reportero Clark Kent, aunque su novia Lois Lane empieza a sospechar algo.

results.title: Superman II: El montaje de Richard Donner
results.original_title: Superman II: The Richard Donner Cut
results.overview: Al contrario que cualquier otra "edición especial" o "versión del director" lanzada en los últimos años, "Superman II: El montaje de Richard Donner" es un film muy diferente a "Superman II" de Richard Lester; la película está remontada e incluye muchas escenas nuevas, como 15 minutos de filmaciones de Marlon Brando. Se descartaron del montaje las secuencias cómicas y la película es así más oscura y dramática.

results.title: Superman III

Pero también habrá tiempo para que Clark Kent vuelva a Smallville para encontrarse con Lana Lang, su novia de la adolescencia.

results.title: Agente Salt
results.overview: Como oficial de la CIA, Evelyn Salt juró un juramento al deber, honor y país. Su lealtad será probada cuando un desertor la acusa de ser un espía ruso. La sal sale corriendo, usando todas sus habilidades y años de experiencia como agente secreto para eludir la captura. Los esfuerzos de Salt por probar su inocencia sólo sirven para poner en duda sus motivos, ya que la caza para descubrir la verdad detrás de su identidad continúa y la pregunta sigue siendo: "¿Quién es la sal?"

results.overview: Based on a shocking true story, Killer Elite pits two of the world’s most elite operatives—Danny, an ex-special ops agent and Hunter, his longtime mentor—against the cunning leader of a secret military society. Covering the globe from Australia to Paris, London and the Middle East, Danny and Hunter are plunged into a highly dangerous game of cat and mouse—where the predators become the prey.

results.title: The Killer Elite
results.overview: Mike Locken is one of the principal members of a group of freelance spies. A significant portion of their work is for the CIA, and while on a case for them one of his friends turns on him and shoots him in the elbow and knee. His assignment, to protect someone, goes down in flames. He is nearly crippled, but with braces is able to again become mobile. For revenge as much as anything else, Mike goes after his ex-friend.

results.title: Gentleman Killer
results.overview: In a disputed border town, the US Army waits for word from Washington as to the rightful country it belongs, while dealing with a rowdy pack of Mexican soldier/bandits. Into the mix rides seemingly mysterious stranger Anthony Steffan, who looks like a dandy but has a few deadly tricks up his sleeve.

results.title: Against the Law

results.title: Asesinos de Élite
results.overview: Tres antiguos miembros de las fuerzas especiales son contratados por un jeque árabe para matar a tres miembros del SAS (Servicio Especial Aéreo británico), culpables de la muerte de tres de sus hijos durante unos disturbios en Omán diez años antes. Dos de ellos aceptan por dinero, mientras que el tercero (Jason Statham) lo hace para salvar la vida de un amigo. Pero llevar a cabo tan peligrosa misión no será nada fácil, pues, aunque son profesionales, están bajo el control de una organización formada por antiguos miembros del SAS, denominada The Feather Men.

With machine sentinels digging to Zion in 72 hours, Neo, Morpheus and Trinity must find the Keymaker to ultimately reach the Source.

results.title: The Matrix Reloaded Revisited
results.overview: The making of The Matrix Reloaded:  Go to the middle movie's furthest reaches via five documentary paths revealing 21 featurettes.

results.title: The Matrix Reloaded: Car Chase
results.overview: This thirty-minute documentary follows the Wachowski sisters and the film's crew through production on the film's famed highway chase sequence. We get interviews with the visual effects supervisors, the stunt coordinators and even are taken through aspects of pre-production and planning for the scene. Then the documentary moves into production, the scariest aspect of which is certainly Carrie Anne-Moss trying to learn to ride a motorcycle good enough to do so safely without helmet for the scene. We also watch as the stretch of freeway used in the film is being built.

results.name: The Losers
results.overview:
The Losers is a British sitcom that aired on ITV in 1978. Written by Alan Coren, it stars Leonard Rossiter and Alfred Molina. The Losers was made for ITV by ATV and was produced and directed by Joe McGrath.

In The Losers, Rossiter plays Sydney Foskett, a wrestling promoter who discovers a young new wrestler called "The Butcher", played by Molina, who Foskett ensures loses to get the public's love.

results.title: The Losers
results.overview: Some bikers are hired by the CIA during the Vietnam War to rescue a captured agent from the clutches of the Red Chinese army. After a round of drinking, fighting, and whoring around, the cycle gang, led by Big Bill Smith, fix up their Yamahas with machine guns, grenades and armor plating, and storm the enemy camp.

results.title: The Born Losers
results.overview: A biker gang incites a reign of terror in a California coastal town that culminates in four teenage girls being raped. Vietnam veteran Billy Jack has had enough, however, and takes on the depraved bikers single-handedly. He rescues young Vicky Barrington from their clutches, but then has to contend with not only the thugs, but also the ineffectual and racist local lawmen, who have it out for the half-Native American Billy.

results.title: The Losers
results.overview: A couple of hard-drinking cardsharp drifters find themselves in the unlikely situation of having to play Cupid. A TV movie / episode of The Dick Powell Theatre.

results.title: The Losers
results.overview: A man chooses to leave the city and goes back to his hometown in the countryside. However, he finds that his dream of being a farmer is shattered as the property developers have flocked into this small town in Southern Taiwan. Consequently, the farmland is taken over by holiday homes and villas, which not only look incongruous in the landscape but have destroyed the serenity. A woman who left home lives in one of the villas. She has been trapped in the house both physically and mentally until she meets the man. Their encounter is about to change everything…

results.title: DC Showcase: The Losers
results.overview: The legendary rag-tag team of World War II outcasts – Captain Storm, Johnny Cloud, “Mile-a Minute” Jones, rookie Gunner and Sarge – find themselves marooned on an uncharted island in the South Pacific that is completely overrun with dinosaurs! Their would-be ally on this deadly mission, the mysterious and beautiful Fan Long of the Chinese Security Agency, tells them their job is to rescue the scientists that have been sent to study the time/space anomaly. Perhaps… but what is her mission?
